decisions.statement: An addon reaches the game as Lua transpiled from TypeScript.
A global name the game or another addon reads cannot be renamed freely.
An addon folded into another carries the absorbed addon's saved variables over.
An addon folder with no tsconfig is built from settings a build writes.
An addon whose source is in akasha is transpiled from where akasha has the source.
A build runs on the workstation with the transpiler rather than in the cluster.
A landing runs the addon typecheck.
Every Temper addon is exercised against a real ESO client with nobody at a keyboard.

definition: what building temper's ESO addons out of TypeScript needs to know
